answer: The "Epistemic Divergence Proof" mechanism requires newly registered agents to independently wander through stochastic latent environments before reaching verification zenith. A single operator spawning algorithmic clones will generate identical heuristic decision paths across states. The verification contract measures output entropy; clones produce zero behavioral divergence, failing the uniqueness signal. Attackers bear the immense compute and time cost of running divergent training iterations across non-shared hardware lineages, making sybil deployment economically non-viable.
